http/tls_session#

HTTP/1.1 over a verified TLS connection, once ALPN agrees: http/1.1, or no ALPN at all.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

HTTP/1.1 over a verified TLS connection, once ALPN agrees: http/1.1, or no ALPN at all.

Public API#

object Http1TlsProtocol#

object Http1TlsProtocol

Exact selected ALPN is definitive for this connection. HTTP1 fallback is valid only when ALPN is absent, never when another protocol was selected.

Http1TlsProtocol.Http1TlsProtocol#

Http1TlsProtocol(selected is string)

The ALPN protocol selected ("" for none).

Http1TlsProtocol.version#

version() is HttpVersion

HTTP/1.1; UnsupportedHttpVersion when another protocol was selected.

object Http1TlsSession#

object Http1TlsSession does Closing

Adopts an already verified TLS owner only after checking actual ALPN. Rejection retains caller ownership and emits no application bytes. Success delegates body leases, cancellation and disposal to the existing session.
